newsitem.title: USA: Assets of U.S. money market funds fell in week.
newsitem.headline: Assets of U.S. money market funds fell in week.

text.p: Total money market mutual fund assets in the week ended May 28 were down slightly to $961 billion from a revised $961.42 billion the prior week, an industry trade group said Thursday.
The Investment Company Institute said assets of the nation's 662 retail money market mutual funds fell $1.6 billion to $640.01 billion in the week.

Of the retail funds, assets of the 403 taxable money market funds fell $1.69 billion to $526.56 billion, while assets of the 259 tax-exempt funds rose $89.1 million to $113.45 billion, the group said.

ICI said assets of the 322 institutional money market funds rose $1.18 billion to $320.99 billion. Of these, assets of the 260 taxable money market funds increased $1.09 billion to $287.42 billion, while assets of the 62 tax-exempt funds rose $97.1 million to $33.57 billion, it said.
ICI revised last week's money market mutual fund assets to $961.42 billion from $961.93 billion.
